Page 3: Data Quality, Provenance, and Measurement Scales

Alt text: Clay models illustrating the four measurement scales, ordinal survey pitfalls, and sentinel screening.

Visual description

Three clay vignettes demonstrate data hygiene: an ascending four-step staircase shows mathematical admissibility from nominal to ratio; a split display warns against calculating arithmetic means on ordinal survey scores; a screening mesh separates artificial sentinel values like -99 from authentic data records.

Complete visible copy

Data Quality, Provenance, and Measurement Scales

Establishing valid mathematical operations and screened denominators

Measurement Scale Hierarchy

Stevens scales govern math validity: nominal sorts, ordinal ranks, interval adds, and ratio calculates proportions.

Categorical Averaging Pitfall

Averaging ordinal tiers conceals polarization; report category counts, proportions, and medians instead.

Screening Sentinels and Missingness

Classify missing mechanisms and isolate sentinel placeholders to prevent severe mean and KPI distortion.

Proper scale checks and clean denominators prepare data for distribution modeling.

Page 4: Describing Distributions: Center, Spread, and Shape

Alt text: Clay balance beams and distribution curves contrasting mean sensitivity against median resistance.

Visual description

The panels illustrate distribution dynamics: a clay seesaw displays how an extreme tail observation shifts the arithmetic mean fulcrum while leaving the median marker unchanged; an asymmetric clay distribution curve highlights the middle fifty percent interquartile range versus extended tail risk; side-by-side plaques emphasize that summary statistics alone cannot replace visual inspection.

Complete visible copy

Describing Distributions: Center, Spread, and Shape

Contrasting parametric metrics with resistant statistics under asymmetry

Center and Resistance

The mean acts as a physical balance point pulled by outliers, whereas the median resists extreme values.

Dispersion and Tail Risk

Standard deviation measures total dispersion around the mean, while IQR robustly captures the central fifty percent.

Limits of Summary Numbers

Identical numerical metrics can mask radically different shapes; always inspect visual distribution geometry.

Understanding distribution asymmetry dictates appropriate visual displays and chart geometry.

Visual description

The first panel depicts an unbroken ribbon of interlocking clay blocks alongside separated pillars on a grounded base to explain continuous versus discrete data representations. The second panel shows a central bracket enclosing mid-range values on a cord with marker posts setting boundaries before solitary outlier beads. The third panel shows four quiet off-white clay cylinders beside one striking deep violet cylinder, demonstrating preattentive visual grouping and intentional decluttering.

Complete visible copy

Visual Evidence and Decluttering

Honest geometric display principles and cognitive load reduction

Continuous Versus Discrete Form

Continuous distributions require contiguous touching intervals; categorical groups require distinct gaps and grounded baselines.

Tukey Fences and Spread

Interquartile boundaries and outer fences isolate extreme outliers without assuming normal symmetry.

Preattentive Focus

Eliminate non-data clutter and apply selective violet accents to spotlight threshold breaches immediately.

Truthful geometric structure and decluttered contrast guide sound operational evaluations.

Grouped Summaries, Comparative Distributions, and Lab Practice

Structuring long data, comparing segments, and auditing reproducible findings

Stacked Versus Unstacked Architecture

Long stacked data consolidates categories into a single column, powering dynamic pivoting and statistical summaries.

Comparative Spread and Fallacies

Always evaluate within-group variance; higher group averages do not mean all group members perform higher.

Reproducible Audit Workflows

Separate raw files, documented cleaning transformations, and final report summaries to maintain baseline audit integrity.

Rigorous data hygiene and distribution analysis culminate in reliable business baseline summaries.
